nodes.author: Kwame_wray
nodes.text: @LateefBaloch07 It’s definitely concerning, but it's reassuring that health experts are saying it's seasonal. Viruses like HMPV can spike during certain times of the year, much like the flu. It’s always good to stay informed and take precautions, but hopefully, it’s just a temporary wave.

nodes.author: juniorsepaahii
nodes.text: @LateefBaloch07 Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is typically seasonal, peaking in late winter and spring. While the rise in cases may seem alarming, it aligns with its usual pattern and is not comparable to COVID-19 in severity or transmissibility.
